text:
maya: Quick readiness sweep for the 3.2.0 launch in the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. Please confirm checklist items and flag any blockers. I want a final go/no-go by 01:45 UTC.

ken: QA sign-off in progress. Test matrix 90% pass. Found a flaky in billing webhook under high concurrency — reproducer attached, but it's rate-limited and non-blocking for the first rollout. Thinking we can ship if we monitor. :thinking_face:

olga: Oncall ack. Pager rotation covered for the window. I'll be primary at 01:30-03:30 UTC. Please make sure SLO playbook links are up-to-date.

lars: Infra: capacity verified for 3x expected sustained qps. DB migration is online and zero-downtime; migration plan: feature branch with flags, rolling schema change. Freeze period starts 01:30 UTC — no infra changes after that except emergency rollback.

nico: Runtime notes — model cache warms during canary, average tail latency ~120ms on canaries. We're pinning the serving image to sha:  sha256:abc123... for reproducible rollout. Canary size 5 nodes, then 20, then full.

priya: Release notes draft posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/3.2.0. Added known issues section for billing webhook flakiness and mitigation steps. Also updated customer-facing changelog blurb.

maya: Summary checklist (please reply with short thumbs or issues):
- [ ] Docs/changelog published
- [ ] QA sign-off or accepted risk
- [ ] Infra capacity & migration confirmed
- [ ] Freeze start time & no-change policy confirmed
- [ ] Rollback plan present
- [ ] Release notes link in release email

ken: QA: we mark docs and sign-off as accepted-risk. I put a regression ticket (ENG-4521) but not blocking. 

lars: Confirm infra & migration. Freeze acknowledged.

olga: Confirmed SRE/Oncall coverage and playbook.

jamie: Devex: CLI rollout guide updated and put pinned snippet for customers that pin to minor/patch. Also added a snippet for auto-fallback config if canary fails.

maya: Rollback plan (high level) — if errors > 3% or tail latency > 500ms for 5m across 3 consecutive probes: immediate canary fail and rollback to v3.1.9. Rollback command (ops):
```bash
# rollback to pinned image
deploy-bot rollback --env=prod --service=frontend --to-image=sha256:def456... --reason="3.2.0 canary fail"
# OR kubectl for emergency
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/frontend frontend=registry.redwood/shim:3.1.9 --record
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout plan for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Canary: 5 nodes at t=+0m; scale to 20 at t=+15m if canary healthy; full at t=+45m. Will post canary health updates in this thread.

maya: Note: Freeze window enforcement — no config changes in console after 01:30 UTC. If someone needs an exception, @maya and @lars must approve with clear risk.

nico: Pinning: The runtime image is pinned in deployment manifests and in the release bundle. Please don't merge any post-freeze image bumps.

ken: Quick QA note: billing repro only happens when feature flag X is enabled + >200 rps. For the launch we're keeping X off for 24h post-launch to reduce risk. I'll toggle after 24h if stable.

priya: Customer comms: scheduled email at 03:15 UTC with release notes link and rollback-safe messaging. Draft: "We deployed improvements to inference routing and cost controls. You may see temporary rate limiting on billing webhooks; no customer data impacted."

olga: One more ops note: make sure to rotate the temporary support token after rollout, as discussed. I'll handle it at 04:00 UTC.

maya: Final call at 01:45 UTC. If you haven't posted a thumbs by then we assume ack but flag immediately if you disagree.

01:46 UTC - jamie: :thumbsup:

01:47 UTC - lars: :thumbsup: all green here

01:48 UTC - ken: :thumbsup: QA accepts the risk (will monitor)

01:49 UTC - priyA: :thumbsup: (typo in handle, corrected) docs and comms ready

01:50 UTC - olga: :thumbsup: oncall ready

02:00 UTC - deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=3.2.0, canary=5 nodes. Tracking: canary health checks enabled.

02:05 UTC - deploy-bot: Canary health: 0 errors / 5 nodes, avg latency 118ms. progressing.

02:20 UTC - deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 20 nodes started. Health checks passing.

02:35 UTC - deploy-bot: Full rollout started. 100% traffic shift in progress.

02:40 UTC - deploy-bot: Full rollout complete: release=3.2.0.

02:42 UTC - ken: Quick smoke — billing webhook tests passing at 500rps. No regressions observed in canary traffic.

02:50 UTC - olga: Monitoring: errors at 0.2% in last 10m, latency stable. Moving to watch mode.

03:10 UTC - nico: Noted a small cache evict burst at 03:05 that caused a 200ms spike for a minute — transient. Will add a metric annotation for next deploy to watch for repeated spikes.

03:15 UTC - priya: Release email sent to customers. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/releases/3.2.0

03:30 UTC - maya: Closing the window. No rollback required. Great work team. Please leave any post-launch notes here for the retro. :tada:

03:40 UTC - lars: Follow-up: we'll run the post-mortem checklist tomorrow; recorded the migration timings in infra runbook.

03:50 UTC - jamie: One doc follow-up: add the canary node counts and ramp timings to the release notes for transparency.

04:00 UTC - olga: Support token rotated as planned.
